en: A sepia-toned historical photograph showing a small open-air market scene. Women in long skirts and shawls and men in caps are gathered around large wicker baskets and goods laid on the ground. On the left is a wooden cart with large wheels loaded with sacks or bundles. In the background stand trees and multi-story masonry buildings with sash windows and shopfronts, suggesting a town square or street market.
